Maybe. Maybe not.
You're oversimplifying the situation. Duviri was - and *is* - far more than just a "place."
and they've filled me in all about the weird little wild world you lived in
You've never been there. You didn't spend centuries there. You haven't lived and died there.
To cut to the chase, Flare? That place is... as much a reflection of me, as it is the storybook it's based on.
While my feelings on it aren't exactly... rosy... I can't very well chuck the Infestation into it and walk away.
And as much as sometimes I like to go back there and repeatedly punch people in the face... It's not my garbage disposal.
Whether I like it or not... I'm somehow, stupidly, the person responsible for that place.
I have just as many pleasant memories of it as I have painful ones.
So it's not your garbage disposal, either.
So I have to be there to protect it when it's in danger.
And just because I wanted to be free of it, doesn't mean I want it all to suffer.
You're asking me to make other people suffer.
Think about what you're asking me to do, Flare.
Would you really want to endanger a whole other world like that?
